verdict.rationale: LangSmith supports several bulk-style workflows: filtering/exporting/comparing many traces via UI or API, building datasets from many historical traces at once, running evaluation experiments across an entire dataset with configurable concurrency/repetitions, and using annotation queues to review outputs in batch. However, there is no explicit documentation of a general-purpose bulk API for mass edit/delete/tag operations across arbitrary item types, and no independent confirmation of bulk operations at scale beyond docs claims. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-edit/bulk-delete API docs, hands-on/community evidence of large-scale bulk operations working smoothly.
